title: HSS eyes RM500mil new job wins this year | The Star
text:
HSS eyes RM500mil new job wins this year | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Engineering and project management consultant HSS Engineers Bhd is eyeing RM500mil in new contract wins in the current financial year, as it bids for RM375mil worth of projects.
Executive vice-chairman Tan Sri Kuna Sittampalam said that apart from tendering for projects within the group’s core expertise in the rail, road and water sectors, it was keen on opportunities from emerging-yet-crucial themes.
